name: pomodoro-md
title: Pomodoro.md
description: Markdown-native pomodoro timer for the LLM era
author: yukitomo26

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Pomodoro
commands.description: Pick a task from your list and start a pomodoro

commands.name: start-break
commands.title: Start Break
commands.description: Start a break timer (stops the current pomodoro if running)

commands.name: quick-start
commands.title: Quick Start
commands.description: Start a pomodoro with the configured quick start task

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.description: Stop the current pomodoro or break timer

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Pomodoro.md Timer
commands.description: Show current pomodoro status in the menu bar

preferences.name: taskMode
preferences.title: Task Mode
preferences.description: Manual: manage tasks in Raycast. Daily Note: load from Obsidian daily notes.

preferences.name: dailyNotePath
preferences.title: Daily Note Directory
preferences.description: Obsidian daily notes directory (required for Daily Note mode)

preferences.name: dailyNoteFormat
preferences.title: Daily Note Filename
preferences.description: Path of today's note relative to the directory. YYYY, MM, DD are replaced with today's date (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD.md or YYYYMM/YYYY-MM-DD.md)

preferences.name: pomoDuration
preferences.title: Pomodoro Duration (Minutes)
preferences.description: Duration of one pomodoro in minutes

preferences.name: timetableHeader
preferences.title: Timetable Header
preferences.description: Section header for timetable in daily notes

preferences.name: logSectionHeader
preferences.title: Log Section Header
preferences.description: Section header for work log in daily notes

preferences.name: breakKeywords
preferences.title: Break Keywords
preferences.description: Comma-separated keywords to identify break blocks

preferences.name: quickStartTask
preferences.title: Quick Start Task Name
preferences.description: Default task name for Quick Start command

preferences.name: enableLogging
preferences.title: Enable Logging
preferences.description: Write pomodoro log to Daily Note after each session
preferences.label: Write log to Daily Note
